items.label: 【Women's Digital Watch】
items.value: Applicable personnel:Womens(Medium or small wrists) and teenagers.Case Diameter=38mm,Wearing Length=140-200mm.This is a pointer and digital women's sports watch with double dial time display, no second hand, simple and fashionable.With 7 kinds of LED backlighting, you can switch your favorite color; featuring alarm, stopwatch, analog digital display, dual time zone, 12/24 hour system, day of the week display, allowing you to read the time easily.

items.label: 【Imported Movement】
items.value: This women's digital analog watch is equipped with Japan original imported quartz movement and battery, accurate timekeeping, long service life, daily leisure, indoor and outdoor activities, you can choose to wear this ladies watch.

items.label: 【Waterproof and scratch resistant】
items.value: 164Ft/ 50M waterproof, suitable for hand washing and cold shower, can withstand sweat, accidental rainfall, etc.. But keep it away from hot water and steam, never press any buttons under water, not suitable for long time underwater activities, such as diving.In addition, this PINIDOUS womens wrist watch also features a high hardness mineral plexiglass mirror with high transparency to avoid daily scratches.

items.label: 【Comfortable to wear】
items.value: PINIDOUS women's digital watch is made of soft reinforced resin strap with small holes design, you can adjust the length of the strap at will, not bulky, comfortable and convenient to wear, suitable for most women's wrists.So you can pick the womens wrist watch as a gift for mother's day, anniversary, birthday, Christmas, Thanksgiving, Valentine's Day.

items: 【After-sales service】：PINIDOUS store is committed to providing better products and 12 months after-sales service. If you have any problems with the quality or watch settings, please feel free to contact us, we will provide you with a satisfactory solution.
